headerDisplay: Shelly Neo Smart Water Valve (Gen3). Shows the valve in Apple Home. Optionally also shows water temperature, pressure (bar) and flow (L/min) (HomeKit has no pressure or flow sensor, so those two appear as Light Sensors: the number is the real value, labelled lux). It can also save a snapshot of the readings every few minutes to a file, for other tools to read.

homeSensors.title: Show temperature, pressure and flow in Apple Home

controlType.title: Control in Apple Home
controlType.description: Switch: a plain On/Off switch, On = water open. Valve: Home's water faucet tile, which shows as running or in use whenever the valve is open, even with no water flowing.

valveSensors.title: Add a Closed sensor and an Alarm sensor to Apple Home
valveSensors.description: Home cannot notify when a valve changes. Closed is a contact sensor (Closed = water off). Alarm trips when the valve shuts without Home telling it to (a valve alarm, the Shelly app or the button), and clears when it opens. Turn on notifications for them in the Home app.

alertAfterMinutes.title: Alert when water has run for (minutes)
alertAfterMinutes.description: Trips the 'running too long' sensor when water has flowed without stopping for this long. 0 turns it off. A bath or garden hose can take this long, so choose what is normal for the home.

alertAfterLitres.title: Alert when a run has used (litres)
alertAfterLitres.description: Same sensor, triggered by volume. 0 turns it off.

shutOffAfterMinutes.title: Shut the water off after (minutes)
shutOffAfterMinutes.description: Closes the valve when water has flowed without stopping for this long. 0 (the default) never shuts it off. The alert stays on until the valve is opened again. This stops a burst pipe but would also cut a bath or hose left running on purpose.

shutOffAfterLitres.title: Shut the water off after a run has used (litres)
shutOffAfterLitres.description: Same, triggered by volume. 0 never shuts it off.

holidayMode.title: Add a Holiday mode switch to Apple Home
holidayMode.description: While it is on, water running for a few minutes trips the 'running too long' sensor, because nobody should be using water. Home remembers the switch across restarts. Turn it on when the home is empty.

holidayAlertMinutes.title: In holiday mode, alert after water has run for (minutes)

holidayShutOffMinutes.title: In holiday mode, shut the water off after (minutes)
holidayShutOffMinutes.description: 0 (the default) never shuts it off. Ten is a sensible choice for an empty home: it closes the valve if water runs for ten minutes.

atmosphericBar.title: Atmospheric pressure (bar)
atmosphericBar.description: The valve shows absolute pressure while no water flows. This is subtracted to give the real water pressure. 1.013 at sea level; lower at altitude.

historyDays.title: Days of history to keep in the snapshot file

snapshotDir.title: Folder for the snapshot file
snapshotDir.description: Leave empty to use a neo-valve folder inside Homebridge's storage folder.

password.title: Password
password.description: The valve's device password. Leave empty if the valve has no password set.
